DIAGNOSIS READY: Neonatal Varicella (Chickenpox)

The description of a generalized erythematous maculopapular rash with pustules that spares the palms and soles is characteristic of varicella. While I see a request to diagnose Pneumonia, that diagnosis does not fit the clinical picture of a skin rash; I will proceed with evaluating for Neonatal Varicella based on the specific symptoms you described.
